history.sg_progress: The Office of Programme Planning, Finance and Budget is committed to ensuring that all guidance provided is unified for all the operational parameters that exist at the United Nations Secretariat. The guidance in the current field manual focuses on the centralized warehouse management of field missions that, at the time of development, did not include warehouse operations of United Nations Headquarters and other non-field entities. The next review of the manual will incorporate warehouse management at Headquarters and other entities as reported in volume I, to ensure that all areas are included.

history.recommendation_text: The Board recommended that the Administration formulate and issue a warehouse management guideline for United Nations Headquarters and other non-peacekeeping operations and urge all entities to implement the requirements and make unified rectifications accordingly.
history.administration_response: In line with paragraph 7 of General Assembly resolution 58/270, which endorses that the replacement cycle for desktop computer equipment should be no less than four years, the Office of Information and Communications Technology supports equipment for a designated period in Headquarters and other non-peacekeeping operations until it declares that support therefor should be terminated. The Office regularly publishes information relating to when it will cease to provide support for computer equipment considered to be obsolete or not capable of operating the supported software. Guidance on the personal computing service is provided on iSeek (un.org). The Office will announce the termination of support for obsolete computer equipment in a timely manner so as to allow client offices enough time to purchase new equipment, especially as the Office is responsible for maintaining the security of the Headquarters local area network.
history.board_assessment: Given that the upcoming review and updates to the field manual on centralized warehousing management, which will include warehouse management of the Headquarters and other non-peacekeeping operations entities, is still in progress, the Board considers this recommendation to be under implementation.
